description: Selected central-to-higher scenario band, rounded from $46.8bn to $103.4bn to approximately $50-100bn. Lower cases are explicitly disclosed; not a confidence interval or bounds. Central model unchanged.
units: Billions of constant 2026 dollars, undiscounted annual payment equivalents

only_2030_and_later_entrants.method: Keep pre-2030 load in billing denominators and its residual upgrade costs in shared revenue; reprice only later entrants. Same investment and demand, collections beginning 2030.

itc.method: Normalize each FY amount by 1.025^(year-2026), then repeat that real ten-year profile three times. This resets the historical ramp each decade. Not an official score or continuing-program forecast.
